title: No official or licensed market price exists in this repository
detail: nfl.com publishes no spreads, totals or moneylines and no operator price has been read in. A parallel desk (nfl-market-desk, session 83a7d6a8) searched the same pages and recorded the same finding in its own price policy P-01. What does exist there is an aggregator (nflverse) reference line of unknown timestamp, which cannot serve as an opening or a closing number. All 39 originated markets on this desk therefore have a blank market column.
consequence: Gates G2, G3 and G4 cannot pass for any family; ROI, CLV and the residual against the market are all undefined.

title: Houston publishes its depth chart as an image
detail: The Texans depth page carries a raster image and no text table, so Houston contributes 0 depth rows.
consequence: Houston's replacement depth, the Houston leg of the matchup matrix and any Houston starter-out count are blank.
action: Find a structured Texans source, or an official snap-count source (S-02).

title: Only one read of the injury report exists
detail: The week-10 report was read once, at 2026-11-15T23:27Z. No delta can be computed and no surprise can be measured.
consequence: R-12 (injury as a surprise), R-21 (delta not level), R-27/R-28 (ablations), R-44 (designation calibration) and R-55 all fail.
action: Re-read the same week later in the week; then decide S-03 for a scheduler.

title: No transactions or reserve list has been read
detail: The official transactions log was not fetched this session, so no IR or reserve list is in the store.
consequence: Absence from the injury report cannot be split into 'available' and 'on a reserve list' (R-64), and depth rows cannot be versioned against roster events (R-34, R-46).
action: Fetch https://www.nfl.com/transactions/ and keep it dated.

title: No official inactive list and no game book has been read
detail: Only club depth charts and the league injury report are in the store; neither confirms who actually started.
consequence: R-10 (availability graph), R-25 (game books), R-31 and R-42 all fail.
action: Decide S-02; the cheapest first step is one club's inactives article.

title: No official snap-count source has been read
detail: Depth is taken from club charts only. No playing-time evidence exists.
consequence: R-11 (depth from playing time) and R-56 (snap proxy when the chart is missing) both fail.
action: Decide S-02; without it Houston has no depth rows at all.

title: No roof designation and no NWS forecast in the store
detail: Neither the official 90-minute roof designation nor any weather grid has been read.
consequence: R-58 is deferred by design (S-05): the feature changes totals pricing, which cannot be scored until F-01 is resolved.

title: No prop prices exist anywhere in this repo
detail: Neither nfl.com nor any aggregator read into this repo carries player-prop lines.
consequence: The prop-combo division produces zero graded bets and gate G7 fails for it.
action: Wait for S-01; prop prices are a separate licensing question.

title: Venue provenance is mixed across the week-11 slate
detail: 12 of 13 venues come from the venue string nfl.com prints on the schedule page; 1 of 13 (MIN@SF) was read from the game centre itself.
consequence: R-23 is partial rather than met. The values agree, but the provenance is not uniform.

title: The 2026 kickoff and onside-kick rule text has not been read
detail: No official rule source was fetched this session.
consequence: R-69 fails; any kickoff-regime prior would be an assumption, so none is applied.
action: Fetch the official rule text before adding the filter.

title: The dated schedule-release announcement was not fetched
detail: The live schedule page is in the store; the announcement beside it is not.
action: Fetch the league's schedule-release news item and record its date.

title: The official results feed holds one season
detail: 145 completed 2026 games and nothing before them.
consequence: R-70 (train/validation/holdout) fails and gate G1 (n >= 300) is unreachable for every family.
action: S-06: extend the official feed backwards, one season at a time.

title: Week 10 was still being played when it was captured
detail: 3 games were live and 2 had not kicked off at 2026-11-15T23:22Z. Their scores are published blank, not filled in.
consequence: The corpus and the standings reconciliation both exclude them, which is why the reconciliation shows a residual.
action: Re-capture after the Monday night game.

title: The Pythagorean exponent is a modelling choice, not an official value
detail: Correlation C8 and the luck panel use an exponent of 2.37, an industry convention rather than a league-published number.
consequence: The luck column is a convention-based estimate and is labelled as such everywhere it appears.
action: Either source an official value or keep the label. No action required to publish.

title: The Patriots defence table was cut off by pagination
detail: The Patriots depth page spans three pages; the defence rows after Christian Elliss were not captured.
consequence: New England's defensive slots are incomplete. New England is on bye in week 11, so no week-11 market is affected.
action: Capture the remaining pages (New England is not needed for week 11 but is needed for week 12).

title: Three decision-readiness desks on this branch count the brief's requirements differently
detail: This desk enumerates 72 requirement lines, nfl-560ed315 publishes 81 and nfl-readiness-cba42531 publishes 85, all from the same brief, on the same day. The counts differ because each desk split the prose into lines differently; none is wrong, but a reader cannot reconcile them.
consequence: Nothing on this desk is wrong, but a reviewer comparing desks will see three different denominators for the same brief.
action: Consolidate at the next integration session (S-12). Until then this desk publishes its count and the rule it used to split the brief into lines.

title: A leakage in the first totals walk-forward was found and corrected
detail: The first run fitted estimator B on the season's final points-for and points-against rates, which include the game being predicted. It appeared to beat the league-average baseline by about a point. Fitting on prior weeks only reverses the result: neither estimator beats the baseline.
consequence: The published totals comparison is the corrected one. Any future estimator must be fitted inside the walk-forward loop, never on the full sample.

title: Team ratings are ridge-penalised
detail: The margin model applies a ridge penalty of 1.0 point squared to the 32 team columns. Without it the model is not identifiable early in a season: after two rounds every team has one home game and one away game, so home advantage cannot be separated from team strength, and the least-squares system is singular.
consequence: Ratings are shrunk toward zero, by roughly 10% at a full season of games. The home-field estimate and every originated line inherit that shrinkage.
action: Pre-registered: do not tune it on the evaluation weeks. Revisit only once more than one season is in the official feed (F-12).

title: Every club labels its own depth chart 'unofficial'
detail: Clubs publish these charts through their communications departments and print that caveat on the page.
consequence: Depth is an official club publication but is not the league's game-day starter list, so it is never reported as an announced starter (R-42).
action: Accepted and labelled on every depth row.
